context.body: Unanswered cry and future praise remain in one prayer rather than canceling each other.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The speaker addresses God as absent and silent, remembers earlier trust, asks for rescue, and anticipates praise among nations and future generations.
observations.label: The absent God becomes the God of praise: action

observations.body: Lament moves through mockery and danger toward testimony and communal worship.
observations.label: The absent God becomes the God of praise: response

observations.body: Why have you forsaken me? · trusted · answered · all nations
observations.label: Words in Psalm 22:1–31

payload.posture: Read Psalm 22:1–31 as prayer and wisdom evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The psalm does not narrate the moment or means by which distress turns to deliverance.
payload.title: The absent God becomes the God of praise
